A single {{PAGENAME}} is required to be donated to the [[Stardew:Museum|Museum]] to complete the collection. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift. ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|gray}}When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} results in a gray color. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
